International Cheese Federation Blog Archive - March 2019
This archive page from the International Cheese Federation website features three blog posts from March 2019. Topics include an educational course on milk quality and herd health, notes from a food safety workshop, and a member spotlight on a producer's dedication to raw-milk cheese. The page also provides general site navigation, categories, and recent posts.

What the herd decides before you do 

 

Milk composition shifts with the season, the feed, and the cow, long before it reaches your vat. Our Milk Quality & Herd Health course starts there instead of the recipe.

Twenty years in, still choosing raw-milk cheese 

 

Kate O’Leary has run cheese programs for two decades. We talked to her about why raw-milk cheese still gets most of her attention, and what she looks for in a producer.
